benefits.name: No GM Intrusion on Intellect Defense
benefits.description: You don't get a GM intrusion if you roll a 1 on an Intellect defense roll.

system.description:
You haunt the woodlands and deep, natural realms, as your people have for millennia.

You gain the following characteristics:

  • You don't get a GM intrusion if you roll a 1 on an Intellect defense roll.
  • You are trained in stealth (if in forested areas).
  • You inflict +1 damage with bows.
